name: Bradyon Veda
source:
It's been three years since the end of the tragic Great War. In the midst of the central city of Moloch in defeated Japan appeared a man, Naoto, bearing the rusted badge of Nephilim.

Nephilim was the 10-man experimental elite special corps who possessed the powers of the gods and annihilated tens of thousands of enemy units. The immense powers which they held scared not only their enemies, but also themselves. Realizing this, their leader Komoe disbanded the group, [spoiler]but an internal struggle arose, leading to her death and Naoto suffering a serious injury.[/spoiler] With the purpose of carrying on her intentions, Naoto stood up to seal those powers which should not remain in this world.

[i]What lies ahead in the future? Will it be sovereignty, harmony or destruction?[/i]

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/01/01/january-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau! Omochikaeri~[/url]]
translation:
悲惨的大战结束后已经三年了。在战败国日本的中心城市莫洛奇，出现了一个佩戴着生锈的拿非利徽章的男人——直人。

拿非利是一支10人的实验性精英特种部队，拥有神一般的力量，歼灭了数以万计的敌军。他们所拥有的巨大力量不仅吓坏了敌人，也吓坏了他们自己。意识到这一点后，他们的队长小萌解散了队伍，[spoiler]但内部争斗随之而来，导致她死亡，直人也身受重伤。[/spoiler]为了延续她的遗志，直人站了出来，封印那些不应留在这个世界上的力量。

[i]未来会是什么？是主权、和谐还是毁灭？[/i]

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/01/01/january-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau! Omochikaeri~[/url]]
